ansatz.label: Our Approach
ansatz.title: Giving something back.
ansatz.lead: We've all benefited from great role models and good coaches. Now it's our turn to pass that knowledge on.
ansatz.p: The Skill Training is more than just sport – it's a chance to show kids what's possible when you train with purpose and believe in yourself. We bring experience from the national team and Europe's top clubs straight to the hall in Uster.
ansatz.feature1Text: Stick handling, shooting, movement – improved with purpose
ansatz.feature2Text: Max. 30 kids – every child gets personal feedback
ansatz.feature3Text: National team players with years of competitive experience

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy.
datenschutz.metaDescription: Privacy policy for improveyourskills.ch — what data we collect, which cookies we use, and your rights.
datenschutz.draftNotice: This page describes, as precisely as we can, how improveyourskills.ch handles data. We wrote it ourselves — it is not legal advice, so please read it through and add to it if needed.
datenschutz.intro: This privacy policy applies to the improveyourskills.ch website.
datenschutz.responsibleBody: The party responsible for data processing on this website is improveyourskills.ch, c/o Claudio Schmid (see legal notice).
datenschutz.dataContactBody: Contact form: when you fill out the form on /kontakt, we store your first name, last name, email address and message to answer your request. We also store a checksum (hash) of your IP address to protect against abuse from automated requests — never the IP address itself.
datenschutz.dataPhotosBody: Photos: the images in the gallery come from our trainings. We obtain consent for publication when registering for the training, outside of this website. Anyone who has not consented is not photographed.
datenschutz.dataLogsBody: Technical logs: as with any web server, our hosting and database providers automatically process technical data (e.g. IP address, time of access) in server logs when the website is accessed. These are used only for security and troubleshooting and are not linked with other data.
datenschutz.dataAdminBody: Admin access: the organisers sign in via a link sent by email, without a password. This sets a session cookie — see below.
datenschutz.cookiesBody: We only use strictly necessary cookies, none for advertising or cross-site tracking:
datenschutz.cookieLocale: A cookie remembers your chosen language.
datenschutz.cookieAdmin: A session cookie keeps signed-in organisers logged into the admin area — only active while one of us is logged in.
datenschutz.cookieTurnstile: On the contact page, Cloudflare Turnstile loads a script that detects form spam and sets its own technical cookies for that purpose — not for advertising or tracking.
datenschutz.cookiesNoBanner: Because we only use cookies that are strictly necessary in this way, we don't show a cookie banner. If we introduce analytics software in future, we'll use a cookieless solution (Cloudflare Web Analytics) and update this section accordingly.
datenschutz.processorsBody: Supabase (database and image storage, data centre in the EU), Vercel (hosting and running the website), Resend (sending emails from the contact form) and Cloudflare (Turnstile spam protection) process data solely on our behalf and for the purposes named above — never for their own purposes.
datenschutz.retentionBody: Contact-form messages remain stored until one of the organisers deletes them manually — there is currently no automatic deletion period.
datenschutz.rightsBody: You can request information about your stored data at any time, as well as its correction, deletion, or restriction of processing. Get in touch using the details in the legal notice. If you believe we are not handling your data correctly, you may also contact the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).
datenschutz.contactBody: For questions about data protection, you can reach us via the contact form or the details in the legal notice.
